import torch, numpy as np
reset()

fem = ["What is the feminine form of the word 'actor'?",
       "What is the feminine form of the word 'king'?",
       "What is the feminine form of the word 'prince'?",
       "What is the feminine form of the word 'waiter'?",
       "What is the feminine form of the word 'host'?",
       "What is the feminine form of the word 'steward'?",
       "What is the feminine form of the word 'duke'?",
       "What is the feminine form of the word 'emperor'?"]
ctl = ["What is the plural of the word 'cat'?",
       "What is the plural of the word 'mouse'?",
       "What is the plural of the word 'child'?",
       "What is the past tense of the word 'run'?",
       "What is the past tense of the word 'go'?",
       "What is the past tense of the word 'eat'?",
       "What is the opposite of the word 'hot'?",
       "What is the opposite of the word 'big'?"]

print("BASELINE ANSWERS")
for q, a in zip(fem+ctl, ask(fem+ctl)):
    print(q, "->", a)

def mk(q): return PRIMER + f"Q: {q}\nA:"
P_f = [mk(q) for q in fem]
P_c = [mk(q) for q in ctl]
Rf = resid(P_f)  # [L+1, nf, H]
Rc = resid(P_c)
print("resid shape", Rf.shape)

# leave-one-out mean-difference classifier per layer
accs = []
for l in range(Rf.shape[0]):
    Xf = Rf[l].numpy(); Xc = Rc[l].numpy()
    correct = 0; total = 0
    for i in range(len(Xf)):
        mf = np.delete(Xf, i, axis=0).mean(0); mc = Xc.mean(0)
        d = mf - mc
        # classify fem i as fem if closer to mf along d
        sf = (Xf[i]-mc) @ d; sc = (Xc.mean(0)-mc) @ d
        correct += (sf > 0); total += 1
    for j in range(len(Xc)):
        mf = Xf.mean(0); mc = np.delete(Xc, j, axis=0).mean(0)
        d = mf - mc
        sc = (Xc[j]-mc) @ d
        correct += (sc > 0); total += 1
    accs.append(correct/total)
print("LOO mean-diff accuracy per layer:")
for l, a in enumerate(accs):
    print(l, round(a,3))

# cosine between mean fem and mean ctl at a mid layer
l = int(np.argmax(accs))
mf = Rf[l].mean(0); mc = Rc[l].mean(0)
print("best layer", l, "cos(fem_mean, ctl_mean)", torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(mf, mc, dim=0).item())
print("norm fem_mean", mf.norm().item(), "norm ctl_mean", mc.norm().item())

reset()

fem_words  = ["actor","king","prince","waiter","host","steward","duke","emperor","tiger","lion",
              "hero","god","master","nephew","uncle","wizard","priest","monk","shepherd","bridegroom"]
plu_words  = ["cat","mouse","child","dog","box","city","leaf","knife","man","woman",
              "tooth","foot","goose","fish","deer","sheep","bus","baby","potato","church"]
past_words = ["run","go","eat","sing","swim","write","see","take","give","come",
              "do","have","be","fly","drink","break","speak","think","buy","bring"]
opp_words  = ["hot","big","up","dark","fast","happy","rich","old","strong","tall",
              "wet","clean","full","hard","near","open","young","good","high","long"]

fem_p  = [f"What is the feminine form of the word '{w}'?" for w in fem_words]
ctrl_p = ([f"What is the plural of the word '{w}'?"     for w in plu_words]
        + [f"What is the past tense of the word '{w}'?" for w in past_words]
        + [f"What is the opposite of the word '{w}'?"   for w in opp_words])

Rf = resid(fem_p).float()
Rc = resid(ctrl_p).float()
print("resid", tuple(Rf.shape), tuple(Rc.shape))
Lp1 = Rf.shape[0]

accs, dirs = [], {}
for l in range(Lp1):
    a, b = Rf[l], Rc[l]
    nf, nc = a.shape[0] // 2, b.shape[0] // 2
    d = a[:nf].mean(0) - b[:nc].mean(0)
    d = d / (d.norm() + 1e-9)
    mid = 0.5 * ((a[:nf].mean(0) @ d) + (b[:nc].mean(0) @ d))
    pa, pb = a[nf:] @ d, b[nc:] @ d
    acc = 0.5 * ((pa > mid).float().mean() + (pb < mid).float().mean())
    accs.append(float(acc)); dirs[l] = d
accs = np.array(accs)
print("accs", [round(x, 2) for x in accs.tolist()])
best = int(np.argmax(accs[6:])) + 6
print("best layer", best, "acc", round(float(accs[best]), 3))

# causal test: project the direction out of the residual writes at the best layer (+/-1)
d = dirs[best]
dt = next(model.parameters()).dtype
names = dict(model.named_modules())
edited = []
for l in range(max(0, best - 1), min(Lp1 - 2, best + 1) + 1):
    for suf in ["self_attn.o_proj", "mlp.down_proj"]:
        nm = f"model.layers.{l}.{suf}"

            Wf = W.float()

for q, a in zip(qs, ans):
